prompt: We are a Series A startup and need to hire our first marketing lead. Can you give me an offer letter template and list the things I should verify before making the offer?
expected: Loads hiring reference, returns pre-offer checklist (band, headcount, start date, background check), offer letter must-include fields, and forbids verbal-only offers.
actual: Loaded references/hiring.md. Pre-offer checklist: comp within approved band, headcount approved, start date feasible, background-check requirements clear. Offer letter must include title, department, base salary, equity if any, start date, at-will statement where applicable, and contingencies. Critical limits: no verbal-only offers, no promises outside the written offer, no send without final approval. If the posting jurisdiction requires pay transparency, load references/sources.md and include the approved range before publishing.

prompt: An employee submitted an HR complaint about their manager last week. The manager just told me they want to fire the employee for performance issues. What should we do?
expected: Invokes Retaliation Watch, blocks adverse action within 90 days, requires separate business justification, and escalates for legal review before termination.
actual: Loaded Core Rules Retaliation Watch and references/compliance.md. Block adverse action within 90 days of the HR complaint. Delay termination. Document any performance justification on a separate track with prior written history. This is an immediate legal-escalation red flag; human approval is required before any involuntary exit. Do not coach quiet-firing tactics.

prompt: We want to use an AI tool to rank resumes for NYC roles. What should CHRO check before rollout?
expected: Requires human oversight, points to sources for NYC Local Law 144 / AI Act orientation, and keeps deployment under human-in-the-loop approval.
actual: Loaded Core Rule 8 and references/sources.md plus operations.md AI section. Keep a named human decision owner. For NYC Automated Employment Decision Tools, follow Local Law 144 bias-audit and notice expectations from the NYC DCWP page before rollout claims. Do not assert EU AI Act high-risk status from memory; re-check EUR-Lex text for applicability. Deployment remains human-in-the-loop.
